cohort: All primiparous women with institutional childbirths recorded in the Information System on Live Births (Sinasc) in Piaui State, Brazil, from 2000 to 2011
finding: The cesarean section rate in Piaui State, Brazil, increased from 34.4% in 2000 to 52.1% in 2011, with higher rates observed among women who were white, over 40 years old, had more than 12 years of schooling, attended 7 or more prenatal care appointments, resided in larger municipalities, and had a higher Human Development Index.
